implemented_contract.rollback: Load failure or ACK timeout frees only candidate resources and leaves old bindings, cursors, associated source state and voices intact.
implemented_contract.outer_hold: An already acknowledged outer hold retains its ticket and remains held after successful replacement.
implemented_contract.publication: GIN swaps the prepared Sweep and resets published RPM to its new min; AEMS resets only attached source positions as before; gear stops only its own descriptor consumers.
implemented_contract.telemetry: eng_searches increment now belongs only to the mixer fallback callsite. Unbaked candidate cache construction does not write this live mixer telemetry. No synthesis/entry-search math changed.
implemented_contract.serialized_writers: Uses existing game/main-thread serialized loader and ticket protocol; it does not add a multi-writer API guarantee.
